form: The dark foot of the well: an earth-floored landing chamber with a heap of sticks and dry leaves, opening onto a long, low passage that turns from raw earth into a brick-vaulted service passage and ends at a right-angle corner into the long hall

grows_from.waking_detail: the burrow under the hedge, read as an earthy tunnel floor of sticks and dry leaves

mucha_design_language.item: Diff from SCN-falling-dream: the Art Nouveau appears progressively as the burrow becomes built passage: over the brick-vaulted two-thirds the vault ribs are cast-iron whiplash arches with verdigris, and the last 8 m before the corner gain a mosaic dado of pastel-and-gold vine tesserae that hands over to SCN-long-hall; the raw earth third stays plain burrow
mucha_design_language.why: The dream's design grows out of the burrow; seamless handover to the hall

structure.item: landing chamber about 3 m across at the foot of the shaft, pitch dark overhead
a long passage about 25 m, clear height 2.1 m, width 1.4 m; the first third has raw earth walls laced with hawthorn roots, the rest a low segmental red-brick vault of the same brick as the shaft
structure.note: dimensions and the earth-to-brick transition inferred (culture_ref geography.json#LOC-rabbit-hole-entrance): the burrow becomes the dream's built passage

structure.item: at the far end a square right-angle corner through which the lamp-lit long hall opens (the only opening in the passage)

materials.item: heap of dry sticks and brown dead leaves about 1 m high and 2 m wide on a packed earth floor
red-brown loam walls with hanging pale root tendrils
soot-darkened red brick vault; floor changes from earth to worn Headington-limestone flags over the last 8 m before the corner
materials.why: Hands the passage over to the hall's stone floor so the corner cut is seamless

details.item: the corner at the end is lit warm by the hall lamps beyond, the rest of the passage in near-darkness
details.note: light positioning is lighting's; this records only that the corner is the sole opening

interior.layout: landing chamber at the east end under the shaft; passage runs straight west about 25 m; right-angle turn north at the far end into SCN-long-hall
openings: shaft opening overhead the landing chamber, black, no light
corner opening at the west end into the long hall, 1.4 m wide x 2.1 m high

scale_notes.rule: True scale: Alice (135 cm) runs upright after the White Rabbit, now a photoreal CGI rabbit (SUP-002 as amended BIB-0027) whose size is set by 04-creatures; the 2.1 m clear height is kept for Alice, camera and the layout.

negative: no mine timbers, rails or lanterns fixed to the walls
no doors, windows or side branches in the passage
no rabbit-sized burrow; the passage is human-sized
no water, no glowing fungus, no magic light
no flat poster illustration, outline graphics or matte-painting finish
prompt_ready_en: the dark foot of a well: a heap of dry sticks and dead leaves on an earth floor, and a long low passage whose raw earth walls with hanging roots turn into a soot-dark red-brick vault on verdigris cast-iron Art Nouveau whiplash ribs, a pastel-and-gold vine mosaic dado near the end, ending in a right-angle corner glowing with warm lamplight, photographed live-action set
